name: Omamail
author: Jason Lee <huacnlee@gmail.com>
description: Read, triage, and reply to Gmail in a native Omarchy window, over the official Gmail API.

barWidget.description: Unread count in the bar; the mailbox itself opens as its own window.

schema.label: Check for mail every (seconds)
schema.description: How often the unread count is refreshed while the panel is closed.

schema.label: Default search
schema.description: Any Gmail search operator, for example `in:inbox -category:promotions`.

schema.label: Notify on new mail
schema.description: Sends a desktop notification when a new unread message arrives in the inbox.

schema.label: Sign-in callback port
schema.description: Loopback port used once during Google sign-in. Change it only if something else already listens there.

schema.label: Clicking the bar icon opens
schema.description: The full window, or a small card with the most recent unread mail.
